challenges.title: Plastic-Free Week
challenges.description: Refuse single-use plastic all week: carry your own bag, bottle, and containers, and say no to plastic cutlery and straws.

challenges.title: Five-Minute Showers
challenges.description: Keep every shower to five minutes or less for a full week. A timer or one song is your guide.

challenges.title: Meat-Free Week
challenges.description: Eat plant-based for a week. Lentils, beans, and seasonal vegetables cover protein without meat.

challenges.title: Zero Food Waste
challenges.description: Plan meals before shopping, use leftovers first, and compost scraps — nothing edible goes in the bin for a week.

challenges.title: Lights-Out Habit
challenges.description: Switch off lights and fans in empty rooms, and unplug chargers and idle devices, every day for two weeks.

challenges.title: Sort Your Waste
challenges.description: Separate recyclables — plastic, paper, metal, glass — from general waste every day for two weeks.

challenges.title: Cold-Wash Laundry
challenges.description: Wash clothes in cold water and line-dry them instead of using a dryer, for two weeks.

challenges.title: Walk & Cycle Short Trips
challenges.description: Make every trip under two kilometres on foot or by bicycle for three weeks.

challenges.title: Grow a Plant
challenges.description: Plant a seed or a small sapling and care for it daily for a month — water, light, and a minute of attention.

challenges.title: Carry a Reusable Kit
challenges.description: Keep a kit with you every day for a month — bottle, bag, cutlery, container — so disposables are never needed.
